name: Change in the poverty rate, 2015-2019 to 2020-2024

metadata.description: Percentage-point change in the share of people below the poverty line, 2015-2019 to 2020-2024, diverging blue (rate fell) to red (rate rose), white at zero. Measured over 3,215 counties with a legitimate chg_pct_below_poverty value (geo_change identical or subdivided; mixed/no_acs_data/absorbed-median counties carry NULL and draw gray): 8 classes with breaks at -6/-3/-1/0/1/3/6 points, which fall at the 6th/21st/48th/65th/79th/91st/97th percentile of the national distribution and none empty (204/476/852/542/451/391/216/83 counties). 64.5% of counties improved (chg below 0).
